title: MSG91 OTP Widget (Mode A verify-access-token) + SendOTP (Mode B) delivery/verify mechanism
context: Forced OTP-provider pivot Evolution(self-hosted WhatsApp, ToS-banned 919059833001) -> Wati(WhatsApp transport) + MSG91 OTP Widget(SMS/voice). Captain-ratified 2026-06-02. This MTC gates the S-146 fix RCA per the mechanism-trust-check-upstream-of-fix-RCA doctrine: MSG91 is a 3rd-party delivery+verify surface the V2 fix depends on.

q1_atomic_primitives.evidence: bono server-side verifyAccessToken is a single HTTP POST (authkey header + {access-token}) -> verified phone. No multi-step pipeline racing a watchdog. Widget client->MSG91 send is MSG91-owned (atomic to us). Downstream issue-opaque-token + pushOtpIssued(HMAC) are existing atomic steps (registration-forwarders.ts).

q2_ttl_bounded_sentinels.evidence: MSG91 access token (15-min widget expiry) + bono otp_verify_token_opaque (<=5min, single-use, phone-bound; registration-store.ts:5-6) are both TTL-bounded and integrated with the verify primitive. No OTA/deploy-sentinel class applies (this is not a binary rollout).

q3_behavioral_verify_success.evidence: Success = MSG91 returns the verified mobile number (binary: valid token -> phone; invalid -> reject), not an echo-string/exit-code. e2e behavioral chain: SMS arrives -> widget access token -> bono verify succeeds -> otp_state row on Server -> createHousehold issues.
q3_behavioral_verify_success.condition: The EXACT verifyAccessToken endpoint/shape must be captured from the MSG91 dashboard Server-Side Integration panel (provisioning item #5) before the behavioral path is fully pinned. Do NOT hardcode from memory. Mock covers tests; live behavioral verify gated on provisioning.

q4_single_target_dry_run.evidence: Flag-gated rollout (default-OFF). MSG91 default template + single test phone before DLT-registered production. No fleet exposure before single-target behavioral pass. Evolution stays live until flag-on cutover.

q5_guard_written_contracts.evidence: Guard contract = the new typed packages/contracts/src/msg91.ts (zod parse = parser-not-regex; parity-gated via check-parity.mjs). Existing guards retained: no-phone-leak gate (assertNoLeakInLogLines), HMAC otp-issued bridge (written contract), env-only secrets (MSG91_WIDGET_ID/_TOKEN/_AUTHKEY). Allowlist: IP whitelist venue 49.204.31.37 (Mode A end-user IP) + Bono VPS 72.60.101.58 (Mode B server IP).
q5_guard_written_contracts.condition: msg91.ts must be authored (item #3 / ask B) as the typed guard contract; until then the guard contract is specified-not-landed.

verdict_rationale: All 5 questions YES. Two conditions to discharge before flag-on cutover (not before the RCA): (Q3) capture the real verifyAccessToken endpoint/shape from the MSG91 dashboard; (Q5) author msg91.ts as the typed guard contract. No question FAILS -> no separate delivery-chain S-146 RCA required; proceed to the OTP fix RCA.
composes_with: S-146 V1<->V2 RCA gate (this MTC is upstream of it)
next_step: Finalize the S-146 5-section RCA (with the 3 bono AMPLIFIER corrections: A2.6 bcrypt-unverified, A2.7 ref token_consume.rs:21, A2.7 framing derived-daily-PIN), then MMA Step 1 DIAGNOSE (>=5 models, OpenRouter) focused on the A2.6 two-layer convergence, then per-PR Captain merge auth.
